_note: Hall definitions. Each hall is the set of faces F_ij (i0 <= i <= i1, j0 <= j <= j1) of an m x n net built by ../gqs.py from the flat angles (alpha_1, beta_1, gamma_1, delta_1) of the base block (kappa_0, nu_0), the types rho_1 .. rho_{n-2} of the rows of blocks, the signs (e_1, e_2, e_3, e_4) and e_0. t = cot(theta_1/2) is the parameter of the base block. Lengths in metres; one gqs.py unit (the length of the edge V_{kappa_0+1,nu_0} V_{kappa_0 nu_0} of the base central face) is metres_per_unit metres.

i.metres_per_unit_rule: span of the deployed midline = 4.00 m
i.t_note: transport position stored at theta_1 = 144.510657 deg, t = 0.3199999976 (t = 0.32 moves the vertices by 1.4e-8 m)
i.transport_mode: low-bed semi-trailer, folded with the two legs side by side

ii.metres_per_unit_rule: span of the deployed midline = 4.50 m
ii.transport_mode: nearly closed loop, through the container door

frame_note: Standing frame of a position: y along the period-two translation V_{i+2,j} - V_ij (the mean direction of the rows of blocks), x along the foot chord (from the midline point of vertex column j0 to that of the last column, times frame_x_sign) made orthogonal to y, z up (towards the midline), y = z x x. Deployed: x = 0 midway between the feet, z = 0 on the foot line, y = 0 at the smallest y of the vertices and panels. Transport: x = 0 in the middle of the box of the vertices and panels, y = 0 and z = 0 at its smallest y and z.
